note: Preview gallery of the clearsky tree window («Польовий КПК») for ui_gallery index=preview/clearsky.json. The window's root is the whole host, the 1600x900 stage centred in it. A fixture only sets texts, colours and visibility: what the skin lays out at run time (the opens chips, the '»' after a branch name, the tier numerals, the gear of a node without an icon, the fog stripes) needs the live menu -- look at it with world_exec oz_research treeui owner=clearsky. A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire.
